newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- CTC started as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- CTC started as neutral.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley initiated coverage of Compaa de Telecomunicaciones de Chile SA with a neutral rating.

-- "In our opinion, the stock is fairly valued and already incorporates the company's good operating conditions and positive outlook," said analyst Luiz Carvalho of Morgan Stanley's Latin American Equity Research Group in a report.

-- It said CTC's stock was fairly valued when Chile's low country risk was taken into account and that "we would be buyers of the stock below $90, but competitive pressures will continue to be strong."
-- The ADR traded this morning in New York at 98-1/8, up 5/8.
